name: token-weather-usage
description: One line above the prompt: context tokens with their weather, a bar per recent prompt, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, the prompt cache with its time left, the session cost with the last prompt's share in dollars and in points of the 5-hour limit, the subagents running, and a one-click pill for the GOs Claude proposes. Labels in English, French or Russian. After Token Weather (Anthropic, Apache-2.0) and the ideas of usage-meter (HolyGrail) and prompt-cache-control (Daniel San).

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in English (en), French (fr) or Russian (ru), or auto: follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG, and falls back to English.

goPill.title: GO pill
goPill.description: Shows a pill at the end of the band when Claude's last answer proposes quoted approvals that start with GO (« GO push », “GO deploy”, "GO merge", `GO commit`); its OK sends them all back as your message. Off: no pill.

workWeek.title: Weekly pace on workdays
workWeek.description: Counts Monday to Friday only (the machine's time zone) when the 7-day limit is compared with the time elapsed: the bar's pace, where the week ends, the run-out warning and what a day may use. For those who leave Claude Code alone at the weekend. Off: the full week.
